ios.desc:
Finally read the books you buy.

Book Reading Habit is a private reading tracker with a focused session timer, streaks, and daily goals that turn 10 minutes a day into finished books.

KEY FEATURES

• Focused reading timer — distraction-free sessions that build a daily habit
• Streaks & stats — pages read, reading time, and patterns that keep you going
• Goals — yearly book goals and daily reading time targets
• Groups — private, invite-only reading groups to read together and follow each other's progress. Not a social network: no feed, no strangers, no likes. Just you and your friends finishing books.
• Library — custom shelves and reading status: To Read, Reading, Finished, Abandoned
• Add books by title, author, or ISBN — or manually
• Notes & voice notes on the books you read
• Year Wrap — view and share your annual reading summary
• iCloud sync across all your devices
• 100% private. No ads. No personal data collected. No data selling.

PREMIUM

• Unlimited books
• Reading goals and advanced insights
• Export your library
• Export notes in PDF, Markdown, Text, or HTML — voice notes are transcribed on-device during export
• Slack, Telegram, and webhook integrations
• Access to all future premium features

By using this app, you agree to:

• Terms of Use: https://bookreadinghabit.com/terms-of-use
• Privacy Policy: https://bookreadinghabit.com/privacy

My first iOS app, a book reading tracker. I used to set a timer every time I was reading a book, but I decided to create an app for myself to track the time, log sessions, organize my books into bookshelves, see progress, etc.

quotes.text:
Working on Book Reading Habit: https://bookreadinghabit.com

Built it because I wanted to read more, but most reading apps either feel too passive or turn everything into social noise. What worked better for me was making reading easy to start: short 5–10 min sessions, pick up where you left off, minimal friction.

So the app is basically centered around habit formation, with stuff like notes, progress tracking, session extension, shelves, and simple organization.

I care a lot about keeping it quiet: no ads, no feed, no unnecessary clutter.

Still early. Mostly trying to understand what actually helps people read more consistently.

Currently only available for iOS, but might release an android version in the future.
